purpose: Verify the manual backup trigger authorization business rule.
preconditions: An authenticated actor attempts to trigger a manual backup.
action_or_input: Attempt POST /api/v1/badms/backups/manual/ as SysAdmin, Super Admin, and a role without backup-manage authority.
expected_result: SysAdmin and Super Admin may trigger the backup; an unauthorized role is denied and no backup is created.

purpose: Verify the respective hod approval for secure archival business rule.
preconditions: A secure archival request is pending and its requester's department is known.
action_or_input: Attempt to decide the request as the requester's department HoD and as a different department's HoD.
expected_result: Only the HoD of the requester's department may decide the request; other HoDs are denied.

purpose: Verify the it security encryption authority business rule.
preconditions: A request is classified Sensitive and awaits encryption configuration.
action_or_input: Attempt to configure encryption as an authorized IT Security Team member and as a non-IT-Security actor.
expected_result: Only authorized IT Security Team members may configure encryption; unauthorized attempts are denied.

purpose: Verify the sysadmin authoritative classification business rule.
preconditions: A secure-archival request has received HoD approval.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign one of Critical, Sensitive, Routine, or Archival as an authorized SysAdmin and as an unauthorized actor.
expected_result: An authorized SysAdmin can assign the authoritative classification after HoD approval; unauthorized classification is denied.

purpose: Verify the sensitive restoration approval business rule.
preconditions: A restoration request concerns data classified Sensitive.
action_or_input: Attempt to proceed with restoration before SysAdmin approval, then approve as SysAdmin and proceed.
expected_result: Sensitive-data restoration cannot proceed before SysAdmin approval; approval is required first.

purpose: Verify the initial data classification and default business rule.
preconditions: A user submits data for archival; test once with a classification and once with the classification omitted.
action_or_input: Submit an archival request with an explicit initial classification, then submit one without a classification.
expected_result: Submitted data carries its initial classification; when omitted, BADMS assigns Routine by default.

purpose: Verify the sensitive data encryption business rule.
preconditions: Data is classified Sensitive and is being prepared for storage and transfer.
action_or_input: Configure encryption for the Sensitive data and inspect the encryption applied at rest and in transit.
expected_result: Sensitive data is encrypted using AES-256 at rest and in transit; blueprint identifies AES-256-GCM.

purpose: Verify the retention by classification business rule.
preconditions: Institute-defined retention policies exist for the applicable classifications.
action_or_input: Assign authoritative classifications and resolve the retention policy for each classified item.
expected_result: Retention rules are selected according to authoritative data classification and institute-defined policy; durations come from configured policy.

purpose: Verify the hod approval for storage extension business rule.
preconditions: A storage-extension request is pending and the actor has or lacks HoD approval authority.
action_or_input: Attempt to decide the request as the respective HoD and as a generic administrator without the required permission.
expected_result: The request requires a HoD decision; generic administrator authority alone is insufficient.

purpose: Verify the hod department scope business rule.
preconditions: Requests and reports exist in at least two departments; actor is a HoD for one department.
action_or_input: Access or act on an item from the HoD's own department and then an item from another department.
expected_result: The HoD can access or act only on own-department requests and reports; cross-department access is denied (404 per blueprint).

purpose: Verify the local schedule overrides global business rule.
preconditions: A valid institution-wide global schedule exists; a valid local schedule may exist for the tested dataset.
action_or_input: Resolve the effective schedule first with a valid local dataset schedule and then without one.
expected_result: The valid local schedule overrides the global schedule for that dataset; otherwise the global schedule applies.

purpose: Verify the schedule parameter validation business rule.
preconditions: A backup schedule is being created or modified.
action_or_input: Submit valid parameters, invalid parameters, and a conflicting schedule including invalid cron syntax where applicable.
expected_result: Only schedules passing parameter and conflict validation are applied; invalid or conflicting parameters are rejected.

purpose: Verify the scheduled repository reachability business rule.
preconditions: A scheduled automatic backup is due; repository endpoint health can be varied.
action_or_input: Execute the scheduled backup once with the repository reachable and once with the repository endpoint unreachable.
expected_result: Scheduled backup succeeds only when its relevant repository is reachable; an unreachable endpoint causes failure.

purpose: Verify the backup failure alert sla business rule.
preconditions: A backup has entered Failed state and the SysAdmin notification channel is configured.
action_or_input: Trigger or simulate a backup failure and measure time until the SysAdmin is alerted.
expected_result: BADMS alerts the SysAdmin within five minutes of the backup failure.

purpose: Verify the repeated failure escalation business rule.
preconditions: A backup has three consecutive failures; escalation recipient is the Director of IT.
action_or_input: Cause three consecutive backup failures and inspect escalation notification and recipient.
expected_result: After three consecutive failures, BADMS escalates the condition to the Director of IT.

purpose: Verify the storage-extension usage validation business rule.
preconditions: A user's authoritative storage quota and current usage are available.
action_or_input: Submit a storage-extension request using usage below quota, at quota, and beyond quota conditions.
expected_result: The request is validated against the user's current storage usage and quota before submission is accepted.

purpose: Verify the storage-extension decision criteria business rule.
preconditions: A storage-extension request includes the user's justification and relevant department context; infrastructure and policy information are available to the HoD.
action_or_input: Have the HoD review the request considering available storage infrastructure, departmental policies, and the user's justification before deciding.
expected_result: The decision process considers all three stated criteria: infrastructure availability, departmental policy, and user justification.

purpose: Verify the special archival super admin authority business rule.
preconditions: A special archival request originates offline from an authority and Sensitive research data requires special archival.
action_or_input: Attempt the special archival operation as Super Admin and as a non-Super-Admin actor.
expected_result: Only the Super Admin may perform the special archival operation in BADMS, regardless of which authority originated the offline request.

purpose: Verify the super admin global backup authority business rule.
preconditions: Institution-wide global backup schedules or default backup policies need to be defined.
action_or_input: Attempt to define or update global backup schedules/defaults as Super Admin and as a lower-privileged role.
expected_result: Only the Super Admin has the stated highest authority to define institution-wide global backup schedules and default backup policies.

purpose: Verify the protected information access scope business rule.
preconditions: Audit logs, request status, backup status, or reports exist across multiple users/departments with different access scopes.
action_or_input: Request protected information within the actor's authorized scope and then request information outside that scope.
expected_result: Only information within the actor's authorized scope is shown; HoD access is restricted to the HoD's department and out-of-scope access returns 404 per blueprint.

purpose: Verify the it security security/rbac authority business rule.
preconditions: Central IAM RBAC administration and BADMS security-policy management are available.
action_or_input: Attempt RBAC permission management through central IAM and security-policy configuration as authorized IT Security members and unauthorized actors.
expected_result: RBAC management is owned exclusively by central IAM; only authorized IT Security Team members may manage assigned security policies and controls.
